passages: 229 fixed context-dependent confirmation passages from natural-model-comparison-v1; same document IDs and targets for all1000.
pool_average: Arithmetic mean across every native pool tokenizer, including the fixed24. Also report pool median and percentile ranks.
primary: Within-domain byte-weighted BPB, equal mean across five domains; compare hard24 arithmetic mean with pool1000 arithmetic mean.
